line_366b0470.speaker: narrator
line_366b0470.text: One sunny morning on Rainbow Island…

line_a4f03612.speaker: otter
line_a4f03612.text: Ta-da! Mosey, meet the Tick-Tock Times Machine!

line_271727a5.speaker: otter
line_271727a5.text: A bathtub that travels through time! It runs on times tables.

line_a74947d0.speaker: mosey
line_a74947d0.text: Could it take us back to the dinosaurs? Mosasaurs swam in the sea back then.

line_702c458b.speaker: otter
line_702c458b.text: Your great-great-great… great-grandma! Answer three sums to wind it up!

line_2dac9fba.speaker: narrator
line_2dac9fba.text: Whoosh! Back, back, back… sixty-six million years!

line_078cca1a.speaker: narrator
line_078cca1a.text: CLANG! The Times Machine crash-landed and burst into six pieces!

line_c7fb4afd.speaker: mosey
line_c7fb4afd.text: Otter, the parts flew off in every direction.

line_4766ee49.speaker: otter
line_4766ee49.text: No parts, no machine. No machine, no way home!

line_1f9ce060.speaker: narrator
line_1f9ce060.text: Then, not very far away, something very big went ROAR.

line_9dddfe45.speaker: mosey
line_9dddfe45.text: Because it's a lot closer now.

line_bf7cf9c8.speaker: otter
line_bf7cf9c8.text: Back to Crash Camp! Time to fit the part.

line_39830939.speaker: mosey
line_39830939.text: Every bolt has to go in just the right place. Let's count carefully.

line_479d54ab.speaker: otter
line_479d54ab.text: It fits! Listen to it tick!

line_e9faf786.speaker: otter
line_e9faf786.text: Campfire sing-along! We sing, you sing with us, and you can stomp along on the drum.

line_3439ce30.speaker: mosey
line_3439ce30.text: We'll sing it three times. A little faster every time!

line_d8745864.speaker: mosey
line_d8745864.text: Before we explore, let's learn a times-table song. It'll help us later!

line_27b3564f.speaker: otter
line_27b3564f.text: Your turn! We sing the start, and you sing the answer.

line_98e08c20.speaker: mosey
line_98e08c20.text: Rex speed! Sing the whole line with us, super fast!

line_aabad790.speaker: otter
line_aabad790.text: Now let's fill the ladder! Type each answer, in order.

line_40e61fa6.speaker: mosey
line_40e61fa6.text: Take your time. The band will wait for you.

line_346dbbaf.speaker: mosey
line_346dbbaf.text: Now the tricky bit. The same times table, all mixed up!

line_eb27150b.speaker: mosey
line_eb27150b.text: That's another times table you know by heart.

line_821832a9.speaker: otter
line_821832a9.text: Hey, don't worry! Why don't you ask a grown-up for some help?

line_85b7cf61.speaker: mosey
line_85b7cf61.text: This one's a bit tricky. How about asking a grown-up to help us?

line_b00136d4.speaker: otter
line_b00136d4.text: You're trying really hard! Shall we get a grown-up to help with this one?

line_1ae1971d.speaker: mosey
line_1ae1971d.text: Even the best explorers ask for help. Why don't you find a grown-up?

line_09890bc9.speaker: mosey
line_09890bc9.text: Look at all these eggs, Otter. They're about to hatch!

line_1555d6bd.speaker: otter
line_1555d6bd.text: Answer the sums and they'll pop open!

line_906273ed.speaker: otter
line_906273ed.text: Baby dinosaurs! They think I'm their mum.

line_e0a3e45b.speaker: mosey
line_e0a3e45b.text: You do have the right hair.

line_49b803dd.speaker: maia
line_49b803dd.text: HONK! Who's that sniffing round my nest?

line_8b02452e.speaker: otter
line_8b02452e.text: Run, Mosey! Pick the path with the right answer!

line_f2bf47f9.speaker: mosey
line_f2bf47f9.text: Right answers make us faster. Go, go, go!

line_c3b19f01.speaker: mosey
line_c3b19f01.text: She's gone back to sit on something shiny.

line_175fd3b2.speaker: mosey
line_175fd3b2.text: This stream is too fast to swim, even for me.

line_d2c0d36c.speaker: otter
line_d2c0d36c.text: Then we'll hop across on the stones with the right numbers!

line_0772ed76.speaker: mosey
line_0772ed76.text: Count carefully. Splashing is not a plan.

line_1c6a9c96.speaker: otter
line_1c6a9c96.text: Shh! Mama Maia is fast asleep on her nest.

line_3b7610d7.speaker: mosey
line_3b7610d7.text: And look what she's sitting on. Our Cog!

line_7f790986.speaker: otter
line_7f790986.text: Each right answer is one tiptoe closer. Quietly!

line_c86ba7e2.speaker: mosey
line_c86ba7e2.text: She's sitting right on top of it.

line_809f0f22.speaker: otter
line_809f0f22.text: Then we'll have to be brave. And quick.

line_5e92f8e7.speaker: maia
line_5e92f8e7.text: HONK! You again! Stay away from my shiny egg!

line_6a436791.speaker: otter
line_6a436791.text: It's not an egg! It's part of our time machine!

line_68985ed0.speaker: mosey
line_68985ed0.text: Answer quickly, Otter. Here she comes!

line_c7aab85e.speaker: otter
line_c7aab85e.text: One part back. Five to go!

line_e5230e5c.speaker: mosey
line_e5230e5c.text: And not a single egg was harmed.

line_388c0ed7.speaker: maia
line_388c0ed7.text: Shoo! Shoo! Nobody touches my shiny egg!

line_13b9a7cb.speaker: maia
line_13b9a7cb.text: Still here? Oh, my poor nerves! Off you go, you little rascals!

line_3443dcae.speaker: maia
line_3443dcae.text: Wait. Since when do eggs go tick-tock?

line_c5ae80fc.speaker: otter
line_c5ae80fc.text: Mama Maia, it isn't an egg. It's the Cog from our time machine!

line_798a3507.speaker: maia
line_798a3507.text: Oh my. Oh dear. I've been keeping a cog warm all week!

line_1af87b78.speaker: maia
line_1af87b78.text: Here, take it, dears. And come back when my real babies hatch!

line_d9a0a256.speaker: trevor
line_d9a0a256.text: Hmph! Who's rustling about in my meadow?

line_886bfe06.speaker: mosey
line_886bfe06.text: This grass is taller than me, and I'm quite tall.

line_fa074ce2.speaker: otter
line_fa074ce2.text: Phew! He's stopped to eat a fern.

line_46502498.speaker: otter
line_46502498.text: A river! And the stepping stones count up in threes.

line_c6bf880c.speaker: mosey
line_c6bf880c.text: Three, six, nine… every stone is in the three times table.

line_63f5644f.speaker: mosey
line_63f5644f.text: Three by three, all the way across.

line_28e75c40.speaker: mosey
line_28e75c40.text: Shh. More eggs, hidden in the long grass.

line_4cbbbfec.speaker: otter
line_4cbbbfec.text: Triceratops eggs! Answer the sums to help them hatch.

line_5809270d.speaker: mosey
line_5809270d.text: Look, Otter. Their horns are tiny.

line_6dd358d5.speaker: mosey
line_6dd358d5.text: Then let's count them in threes.

line_dbea8475.speaker: otter
line_dbea8475.text: Trevor's having a nap. Listen to him snore!

line_815ca7c8.speaker: mosey
line_815ca7c8.text: And there's our Spring, still stuck on his horn.

line_a3371e2b.speaker: otter
line_a3371e2b.text: I can't reach it without waking him.

line_890b3c98.speaker: mosey
line_890b3c98.text: Then we'll have to try when he's awake. Gulp.

line_41d269a7.speaker: trevor
line_41d269a7.text: Hmph! You again! Leave me alone with my bad mood!

line_eed9c2cb.speaker: otter
line_eed9c2cb.text: We can help you, Trevor! Hold still!

line_e1bb94fd.speaker: mosey
line_e1bb94fd.text: He's lowering his horns. Answer fast!

line_42e84a0f.speaker: otter
line_42e84a0f.text: Two parts back. Four to go!

line_7c46a9df.speaker: mosey
line_7c46a9df.text: And Trevor even gave us a smile.

line_0b524b46.speaker: trevor
line_0b524b46.text: Hmph! Off my meadow! I'm far too busy being cross!

line_62a64f5c.speaker: trevor
line_62a64f5c.text: Boing! Boing! Every time I nod, this thing goes boing!

line_f9609889.speaker: trevor
line_f9609889.text: Three horns, and not one of them can reach it. Hmph!

line_3263d7a9.speaker: otter
line_3263d7a9.text: Hold still, Trevor. One, two, three… pop! The Spring's off!

line_5830cccf.speaker: trevor
line_5830cccf.text: My horn! It's stopped boinging! Oh, that's much better.

line_4299d82e.speaker: trevor
line_4299d82e.text: Take your bouncy thing. And, er… thank you. Hmph.

line_6d606106.speaker: mosey
line_6d606106.text: Water! At last, something I'm good at.

line_49e1ffa6.speaker: otter
line_49e1ffa6.text: Swim through the gaps with the right answers!

line_3cdba577.speaker: mosey
line_3cdba577.text: Hold on tight. Mosasaurs are very fast swimmers.

line_fcfe46b3.speaker: mosey
line_fcfe46b3.text: I'm a mosasaur. It's what we do.

line_7002b9a3.speaker: otter
line_7002b9a3.text: Lily pads! Counting up in fours.

line_247b969b.speaker: mosey
line_247b969b.text: Four, eight, twelve… double the twos, then double again.

line_ba0f1325.speaker: otter
line_ba0f1325.text: Hop on the right ones. The wrong ones sink!

line_22afd859.speaker: otter
line_22afd859.text: Four by four, and dry paws!

line_eb2e90df.speaker: mosey
line_eb2e90df.text: Eggs, tucked in the warm mud.

line_ee6c697f.speaker: otter
line_ee6c697f.text: Look at their little back plates!

line_1457be17.speaker: mosey
line_1457be17.text: Tiny stegosauruses. Very spiky, very sweet.

line_b16cf0db.speaker: mosey
line_b16cf0db.text: And the Propeller's spinning on her tail. Whirr, whirr.

line_d91c427e.speaker: mosey
line_d91c427e.text: Every time it spins, her tail twitches.

line_fabd61fa.speaker: otter
line_fabd61fa.text: We need a plan. And a snack.

line_37e8fcd6.speaker: steggy
line_37e8fcd6.text: Who's there? Careful, darlings, my tail is out of control!

line_6ac8200b.speaker: otter
line_6ac8200b.text: We can stop it spinning, Steggy!

line_c534332f.speaker: mosey
line_c534332f.text: Duck, Otter! Here comes that tail!

line_4bd91acb.speaker: mosey
line_4bd91acb.text: And Steggy's walking in straight lines again.

line_5dda75e1.speaker: steggy
line_5dda75e1.text: Darlings, keep back! My tail has a mind of its own today!

line_9c4caeb8.speaker: steggy
line_9c4caeb8.text: Whirr! Whirr! It keeps spinning me round in circles!

line_09898a0a.speaker: steggy
line_09898a0a.text: Four spikes and one silly spinner. Somebody stop it!

line_3d21f234.speaker: mosey
line_3d21f234.text: Hold your tail still, Steggy. Otter, now!

line_8bce79e8.speaker: steggy
line_8bce79e8.text: Oh! It's stopped! I can walk in a straight line again!

line_c792655b.speaker: steggy
line_c792655b.text: Take your spinny thing, darlings. And do visit again!

line_b4dc5c35.speaker: mosey
line_b4dc5c35.text: Something just swooped over my head.

line_3de9d42c.speaker: swoop
line_3de9d42c.text: Swoop! Swoop! Look at the funny furry one!

line_c9b77e9e.speaker: mosey
line_c9b77e9e.text: I know exactly how they feel.

line_66f65191.speaker: otter
line_66f65191.text: Rocky ledges, counting up in eights.

line_89a5e565.speaker: mosey
line_89a5e565.text: Eight, sixteen, twenty-four. Double, double, double!

line_443e0f0d.speaker: otter
line_443e0f0d.text: Me too. Let's never do that again.

line_96b3b252.speaker: mosey
line_96b3b252.text: A nest full of eggs, right on the edge.

line_180aebad.speaker: otter
line_180aebad.text: Little pterosaurs! Let's help them hatch.

line_cab76da6.speaker: mosey
line_cab76da6.text: They'll be flying in no time.

line_c267faa2.speaker: mosey
line_c267faa2.text: And telling everyone they're not dinosaurs.

line_3ba7a526.speaker: otter
line_3ba7a526.text: The Swoop Squad is asleep in their nest.

line_731ba1ee.speaker: mosey
line_731ba1ee.text: And the Bell is right in the middle.

line_bf4b2a53.speaker: otter
line_bf4b2a53.text: Tiptoe up. If it rings, they'll wake!

line_4d0669b3.speaker: narrator
line_4d0669b3.text: Ding-a-ling! The Bell rang on the hour.

line_fbd13f1c.speaker: swoop
line_fbd13f1c.text: Hands off our shiny! Squad, swoop!

line_3a5eb46c.speaker: otter
line_3a5eb46c.text: It's not yours! It's our time machine's Bell!

line_7cb31b49.speaker: otter
line_7cb31b49.text: Four parts back. Only two to go!

line_2b9634f8.speaker: mosey
line_2b9634f8.text: And a lot of very sleepy pterosaurs.

line_5a5dda6e.speaker: swoop
line_5a5dda6e.text: Ooh, shiny! Mine! No, mine! It's the Squad's!

line_ba330db3.speaker: swoop
line_ba330db3.text: Wait. It rings every hour and wakes us all up!

line_16b79691.speaker: otter
line_16b79691.text: It's the Bell from our time machine. It rings every hour!

line_73b704e5.speaker: swoop
line_73b704e5.text: No wonder we've had no sleep! You have it, please!

line_f9f6c6cd.speaker: swoop
line_f9f6c6cd.text: And just so you know, we're pterosaurs, not dinosaurs!

line_655dfc75.speaker: otter
line_655dfc75.text: Raptors! They're like angry chickens! Run!

line_92c408d0.speaker: mosey
line_92c408d0.text: Only because you know your sharing facts.

line_e2b2f5d3.speaker: mosey
line_e2b2f5d3.text: Eggs on a warm rock, all cosy.

line_aa9bc29c.speaker: otter
line_aa9bc29c.text: Share out the numbers to hatch them!

line_9db1914c.speaker: mosey
line_9db1914c.text: I think they want your snack.

line_1f85897d.speaker: otter
line_1f85897d.text: Warm rocks, all in a row!

line_54081308.speaker: mosey
line_54081308.text: Hop on the right numbers and we'll get across.

line_163b872c.speaker: mosey
line_163b872c.text: Next time, let's find a bridge.

line_2f788a4b.speaker: otter
line_2f788a4b.text: Shh. The Snatch Pack is having a nap.

line_48302295.speaker: mosey
line_48302295.text: The Dial is tucked under the biggest one's chin.

line_a61d3eed.speaker: otter
line_a61d3eed.text: Tiptoe closer. Don't step on a feather!

line_03b2de09.speaker: mosey
line_03b2de09.text: One of them's opening an eye.

line_d1ff5b3c.speaker: raptors
line_d1ff5b3c.text: Keep-away! You'll never get it back!

line_df49eb24.speaker: otter
line_df49eb24.text: We will, if we share it out right!

line_fde5f3c4.speaker: mosey
line_fde5f3c4.text: Here they come. Quick sums, Otter!

line_a33e767b.speaker: otter
line_a33e767b.text: Five parts back! Just one to go.

line_89494252.speaker: mosey
line_89494252.text: And I know exactly who has it.

line_e618dd50.speaker: raptors
line_e618dd50.text: Keep-away! Keep-away! You can't catch us!

line_1b598042.speaker: raptors
line_1b598042.text: Throw it to me! No, me! Over here!

line_630ded03.speaker: raptors
line_630ded03.text: Hey, why does it go up to twelve? We can only count to three!

line_75e97583.speaker: otter
line_75e97583.text: It's our Dial. It counts all the way to twelve. Want to learn?

line_8481510c.speaker: raptors
line_8481510c.text: Yes! Teach us! Sharing is more fun than keep-away!

line_9cc90cc5.speaker: raptors
line_9cc90cc5.text: Here's your Dial. Can we count to twelve together?

line_b0f0b464.speaker: mosey
line_b0f0b464.text: Otter. Look at the size of those footprints.

line_4c6a97df.speaker: otter
line_4c6a97df.text: And listen to the size of that snore. It's Rex!

line_cc752ae7.speaker: otter
line_cc752ae7.text: The Times Core is stuck on his back!

line_8048f860.speaker: mosey
line_8048f860.text: No wonder he's grumpy. It's ticking right between his shoulders.

line_885f6769.speaker: otter
line_885f6769.text: Baby T-Rexes! Answer the sums to hatch them.

line_2e44da6d.speaker: mosey
line_2e44da6d.text: I hope they're friendlier than their dad.

line_fa4814f7.speaker: otter
line_fa4814f7.text: They're adorable! Look at their tiny arms!

line_4ead7224.speaker: mosey
line_4ead7224.text: Everything here has tiny arms. I have flippers.

line_c760bf9d.speaker: otter
line_c760bf9d.text: Giant footprints, full of muddy water.

line_de77831e.speaker: mosey
line_de77831e.text: Hop across on the right numbers.

line_d97997e1.speaker: mosey
line_d97997e1.text: He is. And he's coming this way.

line_cf16e0fc.speaker: rex
line_cf16e0fc.text: ROAR! Who's been hatching my babies?

line_f3b0d5fd.speaker: mosey
line_f3b0d5fd.text: I'm a mosasaur! I'm not built for running!

line_c64385e5.speaker: otter
line_c64385e5.text: We made it to the volcano!

line_0076fb1c.speaker: mosey
line_0076fb1c.text: One part left. And it's on his back.

line_28eab721.speaker: rex
line_28eab721.text: ROAR! You can't hide from me forever!

line_c765bd74.speaker: otter
line_c765bd74.text: We don't want to hide. We want to help!

line_79585aa5.speaker: mosey
line_79585aa5.text: Here he comes! Every right answer counts!

line_d45a2021.speaker: otter
line_d45a2021.text: Six parts! The Times Machine is complete!

line_dc9f3b1f.speaker: mosey
line_dc9f3b1f.text: We can go home, Otter. But let's say goodbye first.

line_6cadf52a.speaker: rex
line_6cadf52a.text: ROAR! Everybody run! I'm in a very bad mood!

line_44a760cb.speaker: rex
line_44a760cb.text: ROAR! It ticks and it tocks and it itches!

line_091bb762.speaker: rex
line_091bb762.text: My arms are too short! I can't reach the itch! ROAR!

line_d24f68c5.speaker: otter
line_d24f68c5.text: Rex, the itch is our Times Core! Bend down, and I'll climb up!

line_51154c37.speaker: rex
line_51154c37.text: Oh. Oh! That's the spot! A little to the left! Aaah!

line_d5612a6d.speaker: rex
line_d5612a6d.text: Best scratch ever. Here, take your ticking thing. Friends?

line_007efd23.speaker: narrator
line_007efd23.text: The six parts are back where they belong…

line_3ba09969.speaker: narrator
line_3ba09969.text: The Times Machine is whole again!

line_8d56bff3.speaker: narrator
line_8d56bff3.text: Every dinosaur came to say goodbye!

line_463819c9.speaker: otter
line_463819c9.text: We couldn't have done any of this without you!

line_6ef91606.speaker: mosey
line_6ef91606.text: All those times tables, and you never gave up!

line_1a408b07.speaker: otter
line_1a408b07.text: Three cheers for our champion! Hip hip…

line_4905b29a.speaker: mosey
line_4905b29a.text: Everyone squeeze in for a photo! Say cheese!

line_7b639a2f.speaker: otter
line_7b639a2f.text: Every zone's open now, so you can play any level again, whenever you like!

line_bf21d787.speaker: mosey
line_bf21d787.text: And there are still trophies hiding out there, and stars to win, and pets to find!

line_c103a097.speaker: maia
line_c103a097.text: Goodbye, my dears! Come back when my babies hatch!

line_872228e5.speaker: trevor
line_872228e5.text: Hmph. I'll miss you. A tiny bit. Don't tell anyone.

line_493bf790.speaker: steggy
line_493bf790.text: Goodbye, darlings! Look, I can walk in a straight line!

line_c8a4b699.speaker: raptors
line_c8a4b699.text: One, two, three… all the way to twelve! Bye!

line_a8e3026e.speaker: rex
line_a8e3026e.text: Thank you, little friends. Best scratch ever.
